specification.title: Ortho Planar Project Cursor Constrain
specification.goal: restrict point picks according to drawing mode
specification.owner_rule: This L3 exclusively owns the described capability within its parent L2; any other menu/panel calls it through the parent service contract.
specification.parent_scope: CPlane/World coordinates, gốc F4, nhập điểm chính xác, dựng hình theo view.
specification.parent_exclusions: UI bố cục bốn view thuộc Matrix Book1.

api_contract.input: Typed command/document/geometry data and any selection or builder parameters required by this feature.
api_contract.output: Validated operation result and observable document changes; never silently claim success.
api_contract.edge_cases: Invalid/empty geometry, cancellation and tolerance/pathological input must be handled explicitly.
api_contract.integration: Register one capability owner; adapters dispatch to owning kernel/domain service.

acceptance_tests_auto: Automated: valid input exercises “Ortho Planar Project Cursor Constrain” without panic, leaked handle or stale scene reference.
Automated: invalid, empty, or degenerate input yields an explicit error and leaves document state consistent.
Automated: each operation changes only its documented state and supports undo/cancel where applicable.
acceptance_tests_manual: Manual gate M02: run OpenMatrix9 UI; perform “Ortho Planar Project Cursor Constrain”; observe preview/feedback and commit/cancel behavior.
A visible failure/warning must be shown for unsupported input; the command must never silently do nothing.
invariants: No `90-after` dependency for any M01–M09 deliverable.
No implementation may be assumed from QymCAD until source paths are checked.
Existing document IDs/layer flags/units/history remain consistent after operation.
No separate OCCT operation should be coded inside a Matrix toolbar/menu adapter.

proposed_fixture.tolerance_policy: Use document absolute tolerance of M01; do not guess at source pin; pixel threshold calibrated for DPR.

runtime_implementation.scope: Grid Snap chooses the Ortho octant from the quantized free pointer, then uses the raw pointer to find the closest grid-line crossing along that direction. Planar plus Project uses a parallel plane through the accepted base for object snaps. Typed coordinates bypass pointer constraints. The packaged Matrix Polyline verifies that the add-on start determines that plane.
tests: om9-app snap_panel_modes combined constraints and SDK SnapConstrain base regression
remaining: Measure the prepared fixtures in Matrix9 and complete human M02-UI review.

approved_combined_constraints_2026_11_19.scope: Windows Line readback confirms Grid Snap plus Ortho at (2.5,2.5,0) and Planar plus Project at (7.31,3.27,3) from a Point source at Z=9. Rotated CPlane tests verify marker, preview, Undo and typed bypass.

standalone_verification_2026_10_22.acceptance: Ortho keeps a CPlane axis direction; Planar lands on the active plane; enabling both still yields a point with local z = 0.

sdk_project_stale_cplane_2026_11_18.scope: A loaded SDK query preserves the exact End source and projects it onto the current CPlane when the previous point prompt has an expired context. A live cross-view Line retains its captured CPlane.

sdk_issued_snap_planar_base_2026_11_19.scope: The latest matching issued-hit query supplies from_mm to the point constraints. The loaded package projects the arc witness at Z=2 to Z=3 with Planar plus Project, and uses Z=0 for Project alone or a missing base. Undo and Redo verify the committed Point.

matrix9_combined_constraints_fixture_202.scope: A Rhino 5-format 3DM round-trips two exact Point objects to support manual Grid and Ortho ordering and Planar and Project height comparison. The Matrix9 point acceptance and human gate remain pending.

combined_constraints_preview_and_cmd_202.scope: An inch document with a rotated and translated CPlane exercises all four toggles together. Free viewport input rounds before 45-degree Ortho and keeps the Planar height. A source Point projects to the CPlane with marker/preview/Line agreement. CMD coordinates keep their explicitly typed values. Each Line undoes once.

command_plane_click_feedback_2026_11_18.scope: A Perspective-started Line retains its captured Top plane. A Through Finger click parallel to that plane reports the miss at both point prompts and leaves the document untouched. A compatible view still accepts the point.

standalone_grid_negative_half_step_2026_.scope: After the user approved Matrix9 rounding, OM9 standalone Grid Snap previews and commits X=-2.0 at calibrated raw X=-2.25 and step 0.5 mm. The Looking Down regression verifies neighboring picks, the positive half-step and Undo.
